up: Retrieve activity records for compound CHEMBL1173655 (AFATINIB) and all related molecules found via molecule_hierarchy (parent and salts), filtered to IC50 bioactivity values in nM against target CHEMBL203 (Epidermal growth factor receptor). Return exactly: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Do not limit the number of rows.
sql:
WITH related_mols AS (
    SELECT molregno FROM molecule_dictionary WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1173655'
    UNION
    SELECT molregno FROM molecule_hierarchy WHERE parent_molregno IN (
        SELECT molregno FROM molecule_dictionary WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1173655'
    )
)
SELECT
    md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
    cs.canonical_smiles,
    cr.compound_key,
    CASE WHEN d.pubmed_id IS NOT NULL THEN d.pubmed_id ELSE d.doi END AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
    ass.description AS assay_description,
    a.standard_type,
    a.standard_relation,
    a.standard_value,
    a.standard_units,
    a.activity_comment,
    td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id,
    td.pref_name AS target_name,
    td.organism AS target_organism
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id
JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id
JOIN related_mols rm ON md.molregno = rm.molregno
WHERE
    td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL203'
    AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
    AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
